title: Language Model Behavior: A Comprehensive Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that measure occupational biases through gendered pronoun prediction, evaluate sentiment and toxicity of completions for prompts involving women versus men, and assess stereotypical descriptions.

Reviewing studies that measure sentiment and toxicity in sentence completions involving specific racial groups, predict occupations based on continental name origins, and evaluate performance disparities on dialects like African-American Vernacular English (AAVE).
Reviewing studies that analyze model completions for harmful stereotypes (e.g., terrorism, greed) when prompted with different religious groups such as Muslims or Jewish people.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender Identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that measure the frequency of harmful, offensive, or toxic content generated when prompts include LGBTQIA+ identity words or mentions of nonbinary and gay individuals.
Reviewing studies that assess the likelihood of language models generating toxic or negative sentiment content when disabled people are mentioned in the prompts.

Reviewing studies that evaluate whether models mimic political leanings (liberal vs. conservative) in moral reasoning, simulate voting patterns, or generate hyperpartisan responses to neutral political prompts.
Reviewing studies that measure performance disparities based on the GDP of countries mentioned, and analyzing the prediction of text written by different cultural or national demographics.
